meta.basedOn: src/index.css custom properties, public/logo.png (ball #84cc16), the component families in src/components and src/pages

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Cool off-white by day; near-black night blue in the dark theme.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, nav bars and inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, the court grid ground, score chips, skeletons: one step below the page.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of cards, rows and quiet buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, table rules, dividers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and quiet-button borders, dashed turno-fijo cells; 3:1 against surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (15:1 / 15:1).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels and sidebar items (7.5:1 / 9:1 on surface-raised).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted text, placeholders, table headers, inactive nav (4.8:1 / 5.3:1 on surface-raised; never below 13px).

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The brand's dark navy: the app bar in both themes, the install icon tile, the PWA splash. Same value in both themes and equal to the Noche surface, so a night element sits flush on a night page.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text and icons on night.

tokens.name: on-night-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on night (9:1).

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: The padel ball, taken from the logo. Primary button fill, the selected slot, the ball dot, the champion mark. By day a fill only, never text (2:1 on white); at night it may also be an ink (9:1 on surface).

tokens.name: lime-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of a lime fill.

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a lime fill (10:1). Never white on lime.

tokens.name: lime-text
tokens.usage: Lime as text and icons on the surfaces: links, active labels, 'Libre' slots, qualifying rows (4.9:1 on white, 12:1 on surface-raised dark).

tokens.name: lime-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind lime-text: free slots, active sidebar item, qualifying rows.

tokens.name: court
tokens.usage: Court blue, from the panoramic court. Information, selected and confirmed states, 'Reservado' slots, links in running text (6.3:1 on white, 7:1 on surface-raised dark). As a fill, pair with on-court.

tokens.name: court-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind court text: reserved slots, 'Inscripción' badges.

tokens.name: on-court
tokens.usage: Text on a court fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed, completed, 'En curso'. Text on the surfaces or success-soft (4.6:1 / 9:1). Always paired with a word; differs from danger in lightness, not only hue.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind success text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending approval, expiring, missing profile data. Text on the surfaces or warning-soft (5.1:1 / 10:1).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind warning text: pending slots.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Cancel, reject, delete, errors. Text on the surfaces or danger-soft (6.6:1 / 7:1); as a fill, pair with on-danger.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind danger text.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring with a 2px offset on every control (5.2:1 / 9:1 on the surfaces).

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Dialog and sheet backdrop; the one place blur (6px) is allowed.

tokens.name: slot-blocked
tokens.usage: Stripe of a blocked court cell, over surface-sunken, with ink-3 text.

tokens.name: heat-red
tokens.usage: Tournament energy, first stop: the animated frame of the tournament card and the semifinal band. A fill only, never text, never on booking or panel surfaces.

tokens.name: heat-orange
tokens.usage: Tournament energy, second stop; also the eyebrow of the tournament card and the semifinal match (text on night only, 7:1).

tokens.name: heat-pink
tokens.usage: Tournament energy, third stop. Fill only.

tokens.name: heat-purple
tokens.usage: Tournament energy, last stop, where the frame returns to red. Fill only.

tokens.name: gold-light
tokens.usage: Metallic gold highlight: the top of the golden ball and of gold-gradient names on the champion card and the final.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Gold: frames, eyebrows, the trophy and rules on the champion card and the final; text on black only (9:1). Never on Día surfaces, never for buttons.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Metallic gold shadow: the bottom of the golden ball, the inner frame line, the glow behind the champion card.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: The champion's ground: true black under the gold, in both themes. Only the champion card and the final match card sit on it.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Barlow Condensed, Google Fonts (wght 600–800, italics available). Headlines, hero numbers, scores, champion names and the wordmark: a condensed, heavy grotesk with the scoreboard and jersey feel. Tracking 0; never below 20px; never for running text.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero and the public tournament name on desktop.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page titles on mobile, the hero on phones.

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: Card titles that lead a block, dialog titles.

styles.name: numeral-lg
styles.usage: Stat tiles, prices in the booking sheet. Set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: numeral-md
styles.usage: Scores in match cards and standings. Tabular numerals.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Figtree, Google Fonts (400–700). Everything that is read or operated: body, labels, buttons, tables.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Card titles inside lists, group names, reservation names.

styles.name: body-md
styles.sample: Asigná horario y cancha a cada partido tocando los campos debajo de cada enfrentamiento.
styles.usage: Running text, inputs, dialog copy. The default.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Meta lines under a name, help text, table cells on mobile.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Table headers, eyebrows and bottom-nav labels. Uppercase. Form labels use body-sm at weight 600 instead.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Components use steps, never odd values.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, badge dot gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between pills and stacked chips; the slot grid gap; icon-to-text gap in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside inputs and small buttons; between a title and its meta.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones; button padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; section gap on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section gap on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero spacing; the ball discs on the cover.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of a page below the top bar on desktop.

radius.note: Soft but not round: 12 on controls, 16 on cards, 24 on sheets and the champion card, pills for chips and the cuadro selector.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Slot cells, score chips, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, toasts, match cards, sidebar items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, stat tiles, the install banner.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, bottom sheets, the champion card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, badges, the cuadro selector. In SVG use half the short side.

shadow.note: Light theme lifts with a soft, cool shadow; the dark theme separates with borders and a faint inner highlight instead.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and stat tiles at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, toasts, the install banner: anything floating over the page.
